heading: Video | Modi@25: How India’s Banks Powered a New Era of Growth
paragraphs: India's banking sector has undergone a sweeping transformation over the past 25 years, emerging stronger, deeper and more efficient. The country’s branch network has more than doubled, credit has expanded over 40-fold, and banks are deploying a larger share of deposits to support economic activity. NDTV’s special video, Modi @25: New Era for Banks, traces the milestones that reshaped Indian banking and fueled the country’s growth story.
